article.title: One hour to leave: Hebron families displaced by Israel’s military operation don’t know when they’ll return
article.author: Monjed Jadou
article.content: Israeli forces have forced 407 Palestinian families, nearly 2,650 people, from their homes in Hebron, sealing the city’s entrances and closing the Ibrahimi Mosque to Muslim worshipers. Displaced residents describe being given one hour and one bag.
